# Resource fork fixtures

Finder-Startup.rsrc is a 400-byte classic Mac resource fork transcribed byte for byte from the matching array and Hex Workshop dump in the former src/finder.cpp (commit 8c86cd0). The original dump starts at offset 0x80 in Finder_Startup.bin. This fixture starts at the resource fork header and contains one unnamed fndr resource, ID 0, with a 90-byte payload.
